intrigue.museum: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp (KMSKA), Belgium
intrigue.story: Eleven masked faces offer smiles without trust. The reveal is not a hidden object but a social paradox: everyone has a face, nobody reveals one. The final full image restores the crowd.

scenes.intent: The top hat mask stares out, a calm center amid an uncomfortable crowd
The white face at far left watches from behind another costume
The smiling mask and the floral hat reveal a painted contradiction
The black top hat and pale expression suggest emotional distance
The orange and green hood reveals an unsettling theatrical face
The small face and red clothing compress a crowded corner
The pale eyes and painted mouth seem friendly but feel ambiguous
A grotesque lower-left mask undermines the cheerful carnival colors
The figures on the right offer no safe or trustworthy expression
Reveal all eleven masked figures in the true horizontal composition
